record.title: Preserve one bounded physical private-cache observation
record.intent: Observe stock Setup ownership and both private caches without executing save or accessing FRAM.
requirements: Freeze the validated reader and physical capture/host-isolation wrapper; require fresh full Layer Two capture with graceful shutdown and drop statistics, isolated address and no gateway/DNS/forwarding/NAT/bridge.

Use the existing isolated six-hour lease and authenticated ADB only. Verify current root identity without another root attempt, exact live Sparrow APK pin, PID/start-time and boot identity before helper staging.

Stage one hash-verified helper and execute its positive profile once. No target attachment, calls, memory writes, device IO, option install, reboot or capability change. Helper/evidence staging is an explicit filesystem write.
Preserve raw and partial evidence on any result. Stop on unexpected network, UI, process, mapping, observer or recorder behavior; do not adapt or retry against the specimen inside this task.

Independently reconstruct the ownership/read transcript if accepted, decode streams privately, and distinguish cache equality from physical FRAM durability. Restore temporary host addressing, disconnect ADB, stop lease responder and seal all artifacts.
acceptance: One physical observation or precisely preserved stop has a bounded evidence-backed result.
